records.title: feat(task-editor): add reusable category field for New Task
records.body:
Refs #446 #444.

Independent Maximum Parallel UI foundation from current production main `b4315367edc7d32766b70784267a792dbba99f48`.

## Scope
- reusable field for existing canonical `Task.category`
- create/select/clear category intent
- normalize trim/empty -> null
- known categories are deduplicated and sorted
- Category remains visually and semantically distinct from Tags and Projects
- focused widget regression

## Safety
- no Task schema/store/storage change
- no Project wiring
- no Tag mutation
- no FollowUp/reminder behavior change
- no direct Task write in this slice; canonical editor/apply integration remains separate

Draft Fast first; promote only after exact-head Fast, then current-main sanity and required Build/APK/Device before integration.
